senses.gloss:
Daure-śravas, ‘descendant of Dūreśravas,’ is the patronymic
of the priest Pṛthuśravas, who officiated at the snake sacrifice
described in the Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa (xxv. 15, 3).

Daure-śruta, ‘descendant of Dūreśruta,’ is the patronymic
of the priest Timirgha, who officiated at the snake sacrifice
described in the Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa (xxv. 15, 3).
